negative_snippets: Rooms and washrooms are clean and spacious, although there is a lack of ventilation. They have a very laid back approach towards other services. Wifi connection is unstable and the internet is slow inside rooms. They only have 1 wheelchair for the entire calista resort complex, so you need to wait for an hour for it.
Very budget-friendly stay. Minor issues with shower and TV, but for the price, it’s hard to complain. Good option if you’re on a tight budget
